texts.preamble: Babbu @ Pappu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 January, 2019 1 Crr-6165-2018 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Crr-6165-2018 (Babbu @ Pappu Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 2 Jabalpur, Dated : 11-01-2019
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail. He also submits that there are many contradictions, omissions and improvements in the version of the prosecution witnesses. The Food Inspector was having no power and authority to initiate the proceedings against the present applicant because the place where the alleged incident of proceedings have been initiated, comes under the territorial jurisdiction of Nagar Palik Parisad Chhatarpur, under which only local self authorities are empowered to initiate the proceedings, as the Food Inspector is available in the Nagar Palika. No independent witnesses have supported the case of the 2 CRR-6165-2018 prosecution. He further submits that there is fair chance to succeed in the case.
